English for Professionals

If you use English at work, lessons can focus on the communication skills you need in your professional life.

We can work on meetings, presentations, discussions, explaining complex ideas, working with international colleagues, and other situations where you need to communicate clearly and effectively.

My background in electronics engineering also helps me understand the communication challenges professionals face when discussing technical subjects.

Learn more about English for Professionals

IELTS

Prepare for IELTS with practical lessons focused on the skills that matter for your performance.

I've completed IDP's IELTS teacher training and can explain the assessment criteria and help you work on the areas that are most important for your goals.

Learn more about IELTS

How lessons work

1

Start with your goals

We discuss what you use English for, what you want to improve, and what is currently getting in the way.

2

Spend the lesson using English

You'll speak, discuss ideas, answer questions and practise situations relevant to you.

3

Focus your next steps

We identify what will help you most and decide what to work on next.

About me

I'm an English teacher with over six years of experience. I work mainly with adult professionals and IELTS candidates.

Before becoming an English teacher, I worked as an electronics engineer. That experience helps me understand the communication challenges professionals face, especially when discussing technical subjects or working with international colleagues.
